name: Aura Arcana
summary: Aura Arcana is a free supernatural tarot website paired with the YouTube music channel Aural Arcana: Sonic Mysteries. It offers interactive tarot readings in the browser from a full 78 card deck, interpretations of every tarot card, a tarot practice guide, and a library of original atmospheric music for tarot readings, divination, meditation, ritual and focus.

offerings.name: Free online tarot reading
offerings.description: Four spreads: a one card daily reading, Past Present Future, Situation Challenge Direction, and a five card Compass. Full 78 card deck, optional reversed cards, cryptographic shuffle, no account and no storage of readings.

offerings.name: Tarot card meanings
offerings.description: All 78 cards, each with its own page: symbolism, upright and reversed meanings, keywords and reflective questions.

offerings.name: Music library
offerings.description: Original soundscapes from the YouTube channel, organized by purpose, mood and length: music for tarot sessions, mystical ambient, otherworldly dark ambient, focus and study, epic cinematic, and short sonic mystery video essays.

offerings.name: Tarot guide
offerings.description: Articles on approaching a reading, the Major and Minor Arcana, choosing spreads, and the role of music and atmosphere in divination.

disclaimer: Tarot readings on this site are symbolic interpretations offered for reflection, personal exploration and entertainment. They are not predictions of the future and no outcome is guaranteed.
